DLC2318:3:t_3:20.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Loosen up a little, $$グラハム・エーカー$$.」

DLC2318:3:t_3:23.en:
$$グラハム$$
（Once again, I have learned from watching him lead the way... Young man, just how far ahead of me are you...?）

DLC2318:3:t_3:24.en:
$$グラハム$$
（For now, I will follow in your footsteps. But someday... I hope the day will come when I can catch up, stand beside you, and fight as your friend...）

DLC2318:3:t_3:25.en:
$$グラハム$$
（That is the meaning of my battle, and the proof that I live.）

DLC2318:3:t_3:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Warriors must help one another... $$グラハム$$ and $$刹那$$ bear the same feelings as comrades fighting side by side.」

DLC2318:3:t_3:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I, too, shall await the day when $$グラハム$$, our shy Virgo, can confess his love to $$刹那$$... I mean, hold his head high before him...」

DLC2318:3:t_3:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And with that, everyone... Until we meet again.」

DLC2318:4:t_000:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「The shuttle transmitting the distress signal has been evacuated to safety.」

DLC2318:4:t_000:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Now we need only destroy the enemies pursuing it.」

DLC2318:4:t_000:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Picking up an SOS on patrol...! It's our lucky day!」

DLC2318:4:t_001:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
「The $$新地球皇国$$, just as I thought!」

DLC2318:4:t_001:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「These guys are out of luck.」

DLC2318:4:t_001:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「They're up against the former $$ＡＥＵ$$'s super ace, the former $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$'s top gun, and the former $$ＯＺ$$'s $$ライトニング$$ Count.」

DLC2318:4:t_001:3.en:
$$グラハム$$
「All of us are 'former' something.」

DLC2318:4:t_001:5.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Then let's show them what $c's three aces can do!」

DLC2318:4:t_001:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I am also concerned about the damage to the shuttle! Dispose of the enemy quickly!」

DLC2318:4:t_002:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「But that shuttle's a civilian craft, right? Why was the Empire after it?」

DLC2318:4:t_003:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Let us ask them about it.」

DLC2318:4:t_004:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「There are far more of them this time!」

DLC2318:4:t_004:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「$$パトリック#colasour$$! I am counting on you to protect the shuttle!」

DLC2318:4:t_004:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Roger! But don't do anything reckless!」

DLC2318:4:t_004:3.en:
$$グラハム$$
「...I can make no promises. Let us go, $$ゼクス$$!」

DLC2318:4:t_009:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
「They intend to hold us here!?」

DLC2318:4:t_009:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I have requested reinforcements from $c! All we can do now is destroy them!」

DLC2318:4:t_009:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Damn...! How could this happen...!?」

DLC2318:4:t_010:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
「We cannot pursue the shuttle...!」

DLC2318:4:t_010:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We do not have enough firepower...! At this rate...!」

DLC2318:4:t_011:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
「$$ソレスタルビーイング$$!」

DLC2318:4:t_011:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, spread out! Support Major $$グラハム$$ and $$ゼクス$$!」

DLC2318:4:t_012:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「All enemies have been eliminated.」

DLC2318:4:t_012:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「What about the abducted shuttle?」

DLC2318:4:t_012:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We have lost all trace of it.」

DLC2318:4:t_012:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We have also confirmed a distress signal from Lieutenant $$マネキン$$.」

DLC2318:4:t_012:4.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「That's the Immortal $$コーラサワー$$ for you. He's a tough one.」

DLC2318:4:t_012:5.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Give me his coordinates. I'll go pick him up.」

DLC2318:4:t_013:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$グラハム・エーカー$$...」

DLC2318:4:t_013:4.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I could not protect your friends...」

DLC2318:4:t_013:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「The $$新地球皇国$$ is the root of all this... We're fighting to take it down.」

DLC2318:4:t_013:7.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ロックオン$$ has reported his mission complete. Let's go.」

DLC2318:4:t_013:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「We keep fighting... until peace returns to the world and it can move toward the future. That's all.」

DLC2318:4:t_013:10.en:
$$グラハム$$
（Young man... Your unwavering resolve gives me strength and hope as well.）

DLC2318:4:t_013:11.en:
$$グラハム$$
（I see the future in the path you forge... And so I can begin walking again...）

DLC2318:4:t_100:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Damn you, Empire...! Could you not leave space to $$ネオ・ジオン$$? Have you come out here yourselves!?」

DLC2318:4:t_100:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Do not think you can do as you please with Earth forever!」

DLC2318:4:t_101:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
（Why did the Empire target that shuttle...?）

DLC2318:4:t_101:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
（It is a scheduled civilian flight... Is there something special about one of its passengers...?）

DLC2318:4:t_102:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Too bad for you! You're up against men who are called aces even in $c!」

DLC2318:4:t_102:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I'll teach you why you should fear the man they call the Immortal $$コーラサワー$$!」

DLC2318:4:t_103:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
（$$パトリック#colasour$$... Young man... Can I... protect nothing at all...?）

DLC2318:4:t_103:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I know...! Those who cannot overcome the crisis before them will have no future!」

DLC2318:4:t_104:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$刹那$$... $$沙慈$$ and the others were on that shuttle...」

DLC2318:4:t_104:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「I know... But we have to save everyone...!」

DLC2318:4:t_104:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If you understand that, then I have nothing more to say...! Let's go!」

DLC2318:4:t_104:3.en:
$$刹那$$
（$$沙慈$$, $$ルイス$$... Please be safe! I will rescue you!）

DLC2318:4:t_105:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Those bastards have spread their kidnapping net all the way into space!?」

DLC2318:4:t_105:1.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「We have to stop $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and defeat the Empire...! There's no time to waste!」

DLC2318:4:t_106:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「This is a good opportunity. We'll make sure the Empire knows we've returned to $$蒼の地球$$.」

review.context: Graham accepts his comrades counsel, while battle events show the failed shuttle defense, Colasour surviving, and Setsuna resolving to keep fighting.
decisions: Patrick explicitly uses the Colasour disambiguation token.
Graham asks Patrick to defend the shuttle; Setsuna later promises to rescue Saji and Louise.
The deliberately interrupted Zechs line remains unfinished in English.
